verdict.rationale: DBOS is a library that runs as ordinary Python/TypeScript code with a CLI (dbosctl, dbos) that installs keylessly and works in scripts, workflows can be tested with pytest/unittest, and crash-recovery/checkpointing demonstrates it runs unattended without a UI. Runtime probes confirm the CLI works headlessly in a throwaway environment and docs/API are machine-legible for CI-style automation. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or first-party guidance on running DBOS apps specifically inside CI runners, and self-hosted observability/Conductor was reported by a community user as not yet self-hostable at the time.
